name: Godrej Horizon Wadala

plot.note: 120 m square around the tileset point, accepted as the working plot for now. Replace with the real boundary (GeoJSON Polygon, lng/lat) when available.

podiumNote: Levels not stated on the plan; 4 levels (MLCP + amenity deck) estimated from the render.

layout.source: scripts/analyze_master_plan.py (Green Open Area Intelligence engine + claude:claude-opus-5-5)
layout.description: Three tower outlines in a row along the road frontage on a shared podium. The compass points image-right, so north is 90°: the road (R.A. Kidwai Marg / Char Rasta West) is on the west side and the towers run south to north along it. The podium deck carries the pool, futsal court, lawns and outdoor gym; the ground level has the driveway, MLCP entry/exit and parking under the podium.
warnings: The plan is an illustrative, stylized rendering and is not to scale.
Legend marker 29 on the podium plan is 'Future Development'; it is recorded under futureDevelopment and excluded from the rendering.

towers.name: Tower 1
towers.note: Plan block -> RERA tower mapping assumed in south-to-north order; swap names if the developer confirms otherwise.

futureDevelopment.name: Future development (plan marker 29)
futureDevelopment.note: Not part of the current phases; never extruded. A dashed ground outline is drawn only if a footprint is supplied.

facade.note: white facade with terracotta balcony bands and vertical accent strips; taken from images/exterior-1.jpg

model.note: No developer GLB. The 3D rendering is generated from towers[] (H-shaped twin-wing blocks on the podium) with a facade pattern from the facade colours.
